component.name: Katna PDF
component.summary: Read, edit, sign and organize PDF files

description.p: Katna PDF opens PDF files quickly, even large technical drawings, and edits, fills, signs and organizes them, in the Katna family beside Katna Mail. It is a personal project at an early stage, so keep copies of files that matter.

ul.li: Fast reading, with night and sepia page colours, find, bookmarks and a presentation mode
Edit the text and pictures already on a page, add new ones, and redact for real
Fill and design forms, with totals and formats done for you
Sign with certificate files or USB tokens, timestamps and long-term validation (PAdES)
Compare two versions, measure drawings to scale, and have pages read aloud
A library of your PDFs with tags, stars and search through every page
